description: PHP class defining Subscription API controller for OpenCart, handling subscription-related API endpoints such as cart management, payment and shipping methods, subscription confirmation, and history addition.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class for Subscription API endpoints, extending core Controller class, handling subscription-related actions and API responses.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that handles different API calls based on the 'call' request parameter and returns the result as JSON.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Authenticates and logs in a customer based on provided customer_id, setting session data accordingly.

methods.name: setPaymentAddress
methods.description: Sets the customer's payment address based on provided address ID.

methods.name: setShippingAddress
methods.description: Sets the customer's shipping address based on provided address ID.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available shipping methods after ensuring customer, cart, and addresses are set.

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available payment methods after ensuring customer, cart, and addresses are set.

methods.name: setPaymentMethod
methods.description: Sets the payment method after setting customer, addresses, and available shipping methods.

methods.name: getCart
methods.description: Retrieves current cart details, including products, shipping info, and available methods.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart and returns updated cart details.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms the subscription, validating all necessary data and creating or updating the subscription record.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a history comment or status update to an existing subscription.
